description_en: Creates a function type file in DataStudio
description_zh: 调用CreateUdfFile，在数据开发中创建函数类型文件
kebab_example: aliyun dataworks-public create-udf-file --file-name StringConcat --function-type STRING --class-name com.alibaba.DataWorks.api.udf.StringConcat --resources string-concat-1.0.0.jar,commons-lang-2.6.jar --api-version 2020-05-18 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateUdfFile

parameters.help_en: The path of the folder where the function file is stored
parameters.help_zh: 函数文件所在的文件夹路径
parameters.name: file_folder_path

parameters.help_en: The ID of the DataWorks workspace. You can click the small wrench icon in the upper-right corner of the page to go to the storage management page and view the ID
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的ID，您可以单击页面右上角的小扳手图标，进入工作空间管理页面查看
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en: The categorization of the function, which corresponds to the Function Type field in the Create Function form. Valid values: MATH (mathematical operation function), AGGREGATE (aggregate functions), STRING (character string processing function), DATE (date processing function), ANALYTIC (window function), and OTHER (other function)
parameters.help_zh: 函数的分类，对应创建函数表单中的函数类型一项，包括MATH（数学运算函数）、AGGREGATE（聚合函数）、STRING（字符串处理函数）、DATE（日期处理函数）、ANALYTIC（窗口函数）和OTHER（其他函数）
parameters.name: function_type

parameters.help_en: The name of the class in which the function is defined, which corresponds to the Class Name field in the Create Function form
parameters.help_zh: 函数定义所在的类名，对应创建函数表单的类名一项
parameters.name: class_name

parameters.help_en: The resources referenced by the function, which corresponds to the Resources field in the Create Function form. Separate multiple resource names with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 函数引用的资源名列表，对应创建表中的资源列表。多个资源名称之间使用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: resources

parameters.example: Concatenate several strings to generate a new string
parameters.help_en: The description of the function purpose, which corresponds to the Description field in the Create Function form
parameters.help_zh: 函数用途的说明，对应创建函数表单中的描述
parameters.name: udf_description

parameters.help_en: The command format for invoking the function, which corresponds to the Command Format field in the Create Function form
parameters.help_zh: 函数调用的命令格式，对应创建函数表单中的命令格式
parameters.name: cmd_description

parameters.example: List of strings to be connected
parameters.help_en: The description of the function input parameters, which corresponds to the Parameter Description field in the Create Function form
parameters.help_zh: 函数入参的说明，对应创建函数表单中的参数说明
parameters.name: parameter_description

parameters.example: New strings generated by concatenating all strings before and after the input order
parameters.help_en: The description of the return value of the function, which corresponds to the Return Value field in the Create Function form
parameters.help_zh: 函数的返回值说明，对应创建函数表单中的返回值
parameters.name: return_value

parameters.help_en: The function invocation example, which corresponds to the Example field in the Create Function form
parameters.help_zh: 函数调用示例，对应创建函数表单中的示例
parameters.name: example

parameters.help_en: The unique identifier of the DataWorks workspace, which is the English identifier displayed in the workspace switcher at the top of the DataStudio page
parameters.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的唯一标识符，即数据开发页面顶部切换工作空间处的英文标识
parameters.name: project_identifier

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic creation of the directory specified by the FileFolderPath parameter if it does not exist. Valid values:

true: Automatically creates the directory if it does not exist.

false: The invocation fails if the directory does not exist
parameters.help_zh:
当参数中指定的目录（FileFolderPath）在系统中不存在时，是否自动创建此目录。取值如下：

true：若此目录不存在，自动创建此目录

false：若此目录不存在，调用失败
parameters.name: create_folder_if_not_exists

Data.description_en: The ID of the file after it is created

RequestId.description_en: The unique ID of the request. You can use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用的唯一ID。出现错误后，您可以根据该ID排查问题

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful
